icons.name: save
icons.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production prompt and action icon for Achimeld desktop UI, matching its existing monochrome toolbar glyphs. Generate ONE monochrome pure-white UI glyph on a genuinely transparent background. Crisp flat vector-like solid silhouette with restrained transparent cutouts, consistent medium-heavy visual weight, readable at 20 pixels. Centered square canvas, symbol occupies roughly 80 percent of canvas. No text, letters, badge, surrounding button tile, shadow, glow, gradients, texture, or decoration. Empty space is perfectly transparent. This is a raster icon asset, not a screenshot. Subject: one old-fashioned 3.5-inch floppy disk, viewed straight on, recognizable clipped upper-right corner, a wide upper metal shutter with a simple cutout, and a rectangular lower label cutout. Simple balanced compact silhouette. Used for Unsaved changes header and Save action.
